intro_1: Most people treat staying connected abroad as a coverage problem. Coverage is the easy part. What breaks is everything around it: a price you only see on the bill, a code that never arrives, an order that takes your money and delivers nothing, a balance that can't follow you across borders.
intro_2: Naara is built around those four failures. Below is what each one looks like, and the specific function that closes it.
f1_title: A price you learn after you've paid
f1_text: Roaming and airport SIMs bill in ways you can't predict. On Naara the plan, its validity and the exact charge are on screen before you pay.
f2_title: Data with no number behind it
f2_text: A data-only eSIM can't receive the SMS code your bank just sent. Naara sells data and numbers in one account, on one wallet.
f3_title: You pay, then the order fails
f3_text: Suppliers go down and run out of stock. Naara fails over inside the right lane, and refunds the wallet if nothing can deliver.
f4_title: A balance that can't cross the border
f4_text: Different cards, currencies and apps. Naara keeps one USD wallet that you top up whichever way works where you are.
arch_intro_1: Whether it is an eSIM or a phone number, an order follows one path: price, route, settle, learn. Each stage has a single job.
arch_intro_2: That is why the four failures above stay contained. Here is what each stage does.
s1_text: Every plan and number is priced in one place. The amount quoted at checkout is the amount charged, and the amount on your receipt.
s2_text: eSIMs fail over inside their own lane. Numbers go to the provider that owns that country and type. Lanes never borrow from each other.
s3_text: Every debit is atomic, locked and idempotent, and leaves a ledger row with the balance before and after.
s4_text: A background scorer rates every completed order outcome. It never runs inside a live purchase, so learning can't slow one down.
promise_intro: Three promises, and a specific mechanism behind each. You know what you are buying before you pay. You are connected without waiting on anyone. And if something fails, your money comes back without a ticket.
p1_text: Naara shows what you're buying before you buy it: whether your phone supports eSIM, what a plan includes, and how much data your trip needs.
p2_text: The QR code and manual activation code appear in your account as soon as the order is confirmed. Verification codes show up the moment they arrive.
p3_text: Automatic refunds, a live status page and a support agent that works from your own account keep the trust. NaaraCredits give people a reason to return.
